text: Please relocate the provision crane from port to starboard side to suit our standard port-side berthing at the Sabine Pass terminal.
Owner requires secondary barrier insulation thickness to be increased from 270 mm to 300 mm on all four tanks to guarantee BOR 0.085%/day instead of 0.10%/day as per spec.
Typo in breaker tag: 'ACB-2B' should read 'ACB-2A' to match the cable schedule.
Add a second, fully redundant HFO purifier for the auxiliary engines. Spec calls for one purifier plus a standby filter; we consider this insufficient for our trading pattern.
Please confirm that the hopper tank sloping plate thickness (16 mm) includes the 3 mm corrosion addition required by the class rules for ballast tanks.
Damage stability shall be demonstrated for a 2-compartment flooding case in addition to the IGC Code requirement, per our internal fleet standard.
Change the crew mess table finish from laminate to solid teak. Cost to be borne by Builder as this is a 'similar equipment' item.
The HD compressor foundation shows a 12 mm doubler under the frame; our vibration consultant recommends a 20 mm insert plate instead. Please advise structural impact.
